129:t_1:86.en:
$n
「It's turning out harder than you expected, isn't it?」

129:t_1:88.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「But I did figure out one thing. ...Miss $$スズネ$$ is trying to protect you. In that case...」

129:t_1:89.en:
$n
「I'll get to where I can protect Miss $$スズネ$$.」

129:t_1:90.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「That's right. Do your best, $n.」

129:t_1:91.en:
$n
(I will. But Miss $$スズネ$$ isn't the only one I'm going to protect...)

129:t_1:92.en:
$n
(I want to become able to protect everyone who lives in this world...)

129:t_2:4.en:
$$アムロ$$
「...So $$ゼロ$$ is in $$新日本$$.」

129:t_2:5.en:
$$スザク$$
「Officially, the $$連邦軍$$ under General $$藤堂$$ as supreme commander are defending $$新日本$$, but members of the former $$黒の騎士団$$ are taking part as well.」

129:t_2:6.en:
$$カレン$$
「$$ゼロ$$ is serving as chief strategist and commanding the overall strategy.」

129:t_2:7.en:
$$ゼクス$$
「The $$新地球皇国$$, having conquered the Eurasian continent, seems to be plotting to seize North America and the Pacific Rim.」

129:t_2:8.en:
$$ゼクス$$
「To pin down Japan, which will be the center of the resistance from here on, they probably intend to make $$新日本$$ their beachhead.」

129:t_2:9.en:
$$ノイン$$
「It's not only $$ゼクス$$ and I. Other $$プリベンター$$ members and their collaborators are also taking part in the defense of $$新日本$$.」

129:t_2:10.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「Are $$ヒイロ$$ and the others there too?」

129:t_2:11.en:
$$カレン$$
「It's not just the $$黒の騎士団$$ and the $$プリベンター$$ fighting alongside the $$連邦軍$$.」

129:t_2:12.en:
$$カレン$$
「$$新日本$$ is a country of the Resistance. The citizens are all pulling together, vowing never to let anyone take their country from them again.」

129:t_2:13.en:
$$スザク$$
「Even so, to be safe, we're urging non-combatants to evacuate to Japan.」

129:t_2:14.en:
$n
「Then we have to drive the $$サイデリアル$$ out as quickly as possible.」

129:t_2:15.en:
$$ゼクス$$
「The battle is currently even, but if we can push them back once, we'll be able to shore up our defenses again.」

129:t_2:16.en:
$$アムロ$$
「If we push the Imperial forces in $$新日本$$ back now, that should settle things for the time being...」

129:t_2:17.en:
$$ノイン$$
「Once the situation in $$新日本$$ calms down, we can reorganize our units and put Japan's defenses in order too.」

129:t_2:18.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「So defending $$新日本$$ means defending Japan too.」

129:t_2:19.en:
$$カレン$$
「We came to hit the force that headed for Japan, but we get to return to $$新日本$$ with the best souvenir possible.」

129:t_2:20.en:
$n
「Do you want to drop in on everyone at $$陣代高校$$, $$カレン$$? $$常盤$$ and $$小野Ｄ$$ were shocked when you suddenly transferred out.」

129:t_2:21.en:
$$カレン$$
「I'd love to see $$恭子$$ and the others, but right now I'm $$紅月カレン$$ of the $$黒の騎士団$$.」

129:t_2:22.en:
$$カレン$$
「I'm giving everything I have to protect $$新日本$$... I'll show my face at $$陣代高校$$ after I've done that.」

129:t_2:23.en:
$n
「Got it. Let me help with that too.」

129:t_2:24.en:
$$カレン$$
「Have you changed a little, $n? You've become more dependable, at least.」

129:t_2:27.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「A lot has happened to $n, too.」

129:t_2:28.en:
$$スザク$$
「But I think it's a good trend. His expression has softened.」

129:t_2:29.en:
$$ゼクス$$
「$$スザク$$... The same goes for you.」

129:t_2:31.en:
$$ノイン$$
「Now that you know where you're headed, I believe $$ゼクス$$, $$スザク$$, and $n have all shaken off their hesitation.」

129:t_2:34.en:
$$カレン$$
「Do you want to look good in front of Miss $$スズネ$$ that badly...?」

129:t_2:36.en:
$$スザク$$
「Looks like she hit the mark.」

129:t_2:37.en:
$$カレン$$
「It's fine that you're trying to stop being the quiet type, but you're way too honest.」

129:t_2:38.en:
$$ノイン$$
「I think it's far better than living with a mask hiding your true feelings.」

129:t_2:40.en:
$$ゼクス$$
「...Captain $$アムロ$$, may we proceed now?」

129:t_2:41.en:
$$アムロ$$
「Understood, $$ゼクス$$. Captain $$オットー$$ has already sounded out Director $$大塚$$ about going to $$新日本$$.」

129:t_2:42.en:
$$アムロ$$
「Let's get ready to depart too.」

129:t_2:44.en:
$$アムロ$$
「I know. It was interrupted by the $$サイデリアル$$ attack, after all.」

129:t_2:45.en:
$n
「Yes... I'll go down to $$第３新東京市$$ on my own two feet and vow victory to $$シンジ$$ and the others.」

129:t_10:3.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「It's been a long time, Miss $$カレン$$.」

129:t_10:5.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「How cruel...! I'm a member of $c too!」

129:t_10:6.en:
$$カレン$$
「Sorry, sorry. Anyway, I'm heading out with $n and the others now, so see you later.」

129:t_10:7.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I understand, Miss $$カレン$$. You're thinking of Mr. $$シンジ$$.」

129:t_10:8.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Miss $$カレン$$... You doted on Mr. $$シンジ$$ like a little brother, didn't you...」

129:t_10:9.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Those feelings and your resolve to fight produced $$Ｚチップ$$ worth 50 Z. I'll add them to the unit's stock.」

129:t_10:10.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Then I too will pray, quietly behind the scenes, that Miss $$カレン$$ and everyone can be reunited with Mr. $$シンジ$$ and the others.」

129:t_10:15.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「It's been a while, Mr. $$ゼクス$$, Miss $$ノイン$$.」

129:t_10:16.en:
$$ゼクス$$
「AG, is it...? We'll be in your care again.」

129:t_10:17.en:
$$ノイン$$
「But don't say anything unnecessary. Your quips stress $$ゼクス$$ out.」

129:t_10:18.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Understood. I have no intention of heckling a serious situation like $$新日本$$ being in a pinch.」

129:t_10:19.en:
$$ゼクス$$
「Sorry, $$ノイン$$. I made you worry about me again.」

129:t_10:20.en:
$$ノイン$$
「Please don't mind. I do it because I want to.」

129:t_10:21.en:
$$ゼクス$$
「Even so, allow me to say it. Thank you, $$ノイン$$.」

129:t_10:23.en:
$$ゼクス$$
「Perhaps $n inspired me. I want to break away from who I was yesterday and always be a new self, too.」

129:t_10:24.en:
$$ノイン$$
「Admirable, $$ゼクス$$. It's because you're like that that I follow you.」

129:t_10:27.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Um! I don't mean to say anything unnecessary, but please don't start your own two-person world in front of somebody else's shop!」

129:t_10:29.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Grrr!! That composed attitude really gets under my skin!」

129:t_10:30.en:
$$ゼクス$$
「Then, to make up for it, I'll help with your work.」

129:t_10:32.en:
$$ゼクス$$
「Another day of giving it my all... business, business... ...Is this right?」

129:t_10:34.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Th-that handsome, royal, ace composure is frying my circuits!」

129:t_10:35.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Grrrrrr!! This is the most humiliating commercial in $$Ｄトレーダー$$ history!!」
